Purpose: Authoritative regression contract for processes AV Workstation Toolkit directly launches. This file documents boundaries and does not grant execution authority.

Launches.Boundary: Explicit --legacy-powershell-recovery only. There is no automatic fallback from the default compiled App; the launcher constructs this fixed argument vector and rejects unsupported arguments.

Available only through the explicit Phase 13 legacy recovery runtime. Only a direct request JSON child of AV Workstation Toolkit logs\requests is accepted; the legacy worker revalidates exact package IDs and policy.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled AV Workstation Toolkit WPF App
Launches.Boundary: The in-process bootstrap supplies the embedded worker SHA-256. The compiled App can launch only that regular, hash-matched, product-identified worker at the exact packaged runtime path with a canonical correlated request.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled read-only inventory provider or compiled production worker; explicit legacy recovery runtime only when requested
Launches.Boundary: The executable must be the registered Microsoft Desktop App Installer winget.exe beneath protected Program Files\WindowsApps with a valid Microsoft Authenticode signature. Inventory uses fixed read-only vectors. Production change actions are internally constructed Install/Update vectors for one exact reauthorized managed catalog package ID.

Temporary recovery compatibility only. The constant bridge argument is the only process argument. Strict bounded JSON travels over redirected standard input; credentials never enter arguments or environment variables.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled WPF App or explicit legacy recovery runtime
Launches.Boundary: Used only for explicit Open logs and Show verified file actions. AV Workstation Toolkit does not execute the selected installer.

Launches.Initiator: Compiled WPF App or explicit legacy recovery runtime
Launches.Boundary: Used only for explicit operator requests to open catalogued official product or download pages.
Optional read-only snapshot collection only; not part of normal desktop startup.
